items.title: Satya Nadella: “If Amazon Doesn’t, Shop Will.” Shopify Just Gained 15% in a Week. Time to Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysShopify shares gained 15% in the past week as tech rebounded with Nvidia and DZ Bank upgraded Shopify to Buy. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says if Amazon won’t accept shoppers’ AI agents, someone else will, and Shopify is set up to be that someone.

items.title: Jeff Bezos predicted Amazon would go bankrupt one day. Only one Fortune 500 No. 1 ever has
items.summary: Bezos once told employees Amazon would go bankrupt. Now 32, it's No. 1 on the 2026 Fortune 500 and spending about $220 billion this year, mostly on AI and AWS.

items.title: Learn Why The Bull Case For Walmart (WMT) Could Change Following Earnings Beat
items.summary: Walmart has reported third quarter revenue of US$188.8b and net income of US$4.9b, raised full year guidance, ramped up holiday value offers such as a US$35 Thanksgiving meal and FabFitFun beauty boxes, and continued buybacks while investors rotated more capital into consumer staples. The retailer is pairing price focused grocery and holiday promotions with expanding e-commerce tools, such as AI shopping assistants and digital shelf tags. items.title: U.S. Black Friday online sales set to exceed $13 billion, Adobe predicts
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. online spending on Black Friday is expected to exceed $13 billion, according to Adobe Analytics, as shoppers pursue holiday discounts amid persistent inflation and elevated gasoline prices.

items.title: Walmart bets shoppers won't notice its holiday price increases
items.summary: The retail giant made a big change heading into Black Friday, and one expert warns it can only get away with it for so long.

items.title: Walmart vs. Target: One Has Triple the Dividend, and It's the Better Buy
items.summary: Target yields 2.7%, more than triple Walmart's 0.75%, and trades near 19x forward earnings versus Walmart's 44x. Walmart wins on growth, but Target is the better deal for dividend investors.

items.title: e.l.f. Beauty vs. Wendy's: Which Consumer Goods Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: e.l.f. is growing fast and expanding overseas, though growth is expected to cool and it carries debt. Wendy's is a household name with a turnaround plan, but its U.S. sales are falling.
